import datetime,json,os,subprocess,sys,time
from pathlib import Path
run=Path(sys.argv[1]); prep_pid=int(sys.argv[2])
def record(state,**values):
 p=run/'PIPELINE.json'; t=p.with_suffix('.json.tmp')
 t.write_text(json.dumps(dict(state=state,updated_at=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),supervisor_pid=os.getpid(),**values),ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n'); t.replace(p)
try:
 record('waiting_for_preparation')
 while True:
  state=json.loads((run/'STATUS.json').read_text())
  if state['status']=='prepared_waiting_preflight': break
  if state['status']=='failed': raise RuntimeError('Preparation failed: '+repr(state))
  stat=Path('/proc')/str(prep_pid)/'stat'
  if not stat.exists() or stat.read_text().split()[2]=='Z': raise RuntimeError('Preparation exited before ready')
  time.sleep(5)
 audit=json.loads((run/'baseline/CPU_RECHECK.json').read_text())
 if audit['status']!='independent_cpu_passed': raise RuntimeError('Baseline CPU audit not passed')
 cmd=[sys.executable,'-u','-m','experiments.offline_camera_retrain_v1.ops.exo_control_trial','run','--run',str(run),'--prepared']
 with (run/'train.log').open('ab') as log:
  child=subprocess.Popen(cmd,stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
  record('preflight_and_training',child_pid=child.pid,command=cmd)
  result=child.wait()
 if result: raise RuntimeError('Training/preflight process exited '+str(result))
 record('final_usability_report')
 cmd=[sys.executable,'-u','-m','experiments.offline_camera_retrain_v1.ops.exo_control_report','--run',str(run),'--baseline',str(run/'baseline')]
 with (run/'report.log').open('ab') as log: subprocess.run(cmd,stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True)
 record('completed',report=str(run/'USABILITY_zh.md'))
except BaseException as exc:
 record('failed',error=repr(exc)); raise
